messages.author: c0733c2c6fdda5c6
messages.subject: R Data Miner ODBC dont't connect...
parts:
I'm novice to Rattle.
I'm train to apply it to a Microsoft SQL Server 2000.
I am using XP with Rattle 2.3.65 .
My XP services packs are up to date.

Here, Rattle don't find DSN.
DNS is the there.
In RGui, odbcConnect("Tese") is aware of DSN, but,
puttin DSN on R Data Miner, happens nothing whe I press Enter.

If someone can help... I have no idea anymore.


Thank your.

Hi,

Thanks Edgaar, but I've put my problem on your subject cause it's the
same problem, and so, it's no necessary to create an other subject for
the same problem, I think (and maybe others readers thinks it's ok).
So, it's a problem, and it's a serious problem, cause ODBC is the only
way to take data from others databases like mySQL, Oracle or
Terradata.
And I need it a lot.

The Rattle version I'm using is the 2.3.76 and the R version is the
2.7.1.

PS, ODBC is not only a MS product (even if they try to say that), MS
was just on the team of the ODBC development, so we can use ODBC on
Linux too.
